s1.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged woman with a long-standing breast lump and axillary discomfort
salient_findings: mobile lump in the right breast
migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
multiple hypoechoic masses on breast ultrasonography
key_facts: no family history of breast cancer
mobile lump palpated in the right breast
breast ultrasonography revealed multiple hypoechoic masses
no obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

raw.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged woman with a long-standing breast lump and axillary discomfort
salient_findings: mobile lump in the right breast
migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
multiple hypoechoic masses on breast ultrasonography
key_facts: no family history of breast cancer
mobile lump palpated in the right breast
breast ultrasonography revealed multiple hypoechoic masses
no obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

shortlist.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: most common type of breast cancer, matches the patient's age and presentation

shortlist.label: Invasive lobular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: second most common type of breast cancer, possible given the patient's menopausal status and mobile lump

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: matches the description of a mobile lump and can present with multiple masses on ultrasonography

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: common benign breast tumor, possible given the patient's age and mobile lump

shortlist.label: Ductal carcinoma in situ
shortlist.why_kept: pre-invasive cancer, possible given the patient's long-standing breast lump and ultrasonography findings

raw.rationale: The presence of a mobile lump and multiple hypoechoic masses with varying sizes on ultrasonography, along with the absence of obvious blood-flow signals, is more suggestive of a Phyllodes tumor, which can be benign, borderline, or malignant and often presents with a palpable mass and variable ultrasonographic features.

rejected.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a harder, less mobile mass and more irregular margins on imaging.

rejected.label: Invasive lobular carcinoma
rejected.why: Often presents with a more subtle clinical and radiological appearance, not typically with multiple distinct masses.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Usually presents as a single, well-defined, and highly mobile mass, which does not fully explain the multiple lesions seen in this case.

rejected.label: Ductal carcinoma in situ
rejected.why: Does not typically present as a palpable lump and is often detected by mammography as microcalcifications.
